_comment: Build-time settings. catalogUrl is where CI publishes the profile catalog (.github/workflows/profiles.yml); its origin becomes the extension's host permission. fallbackProfiles: target printers to offer offline, plus the source profiles of Bambu projects (original values in reports). featuredModels: printer_model names shown first in the printer picker (the rest by search or brand); names missing from the catalog are ignored. makerworldOrigins: sites where the MakerWorld integration runs (content scripts and the bridge page).
